target.title: feat(cli): animate the claw banner and show it on gateway startup
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

The wizard banner that landed in #105119 is static, and the foreground gateway (`openclaw gateway`) starts with no visual identity at all — just a module-loading spinner. Peter asked for the banner to move (combining the left-to-right reveal, the shimmer, and the claw pinch from the animation prototypes) and to appear on Gateway startup too.

## Why This Change Was Made

New `src/cli/claw-banner.ts` owns the banner art and a single combined entrance animation: a left-to-right molt wipe (dim shell ahead of a bright edge, color behind), a shimmer band sweeping the wordmark, and claw snips. An injectable rng varies the garnish a little per run (rarely a second shimmer pass, sometimes a double snip) so back-to-back runs don't feel canned; every sequence ends on the exact static banner. Chosen combo and randomization were an explicit maintainer request ("I like a combination of the left-to-right animation + shimmer and the pinching … We could randomize it a little bit").

`printWizardHeader` in `onboard-helpers.ts` is now a thin async delegate to `printClawBanner` (art constants moved out; doctor/onboard/configure callers await it). The foreground gateway run prints the banner before the module-loading spinner, only when stdout is a TTY.

Gating is strict and additive-only: animation requires interactive TTY + rich color, and is disabled under `CI`/`VITEST`; non-animatable paths print the same static banner as before; terminals narrower than the art keep the plain-title fallback; non-TTY gateway runs (launchd, piped logs, tests) print nothing new. No new config or env surface. Raw ANSI cursor moves, no new dependencies; worst-case sequence is ~1.5s and runs before the first prompt renders.

## User Impact

- `openclaw doctor` / `onboard` / `configure` on an interactive rich terminal: the banner animates in (~1–1.5s), then behaves exactly as today.
- `openclaw gateway` run in a terminal: shows the (animated) banner at startup. Managed/piped gateway runs are unchanged — no art in launchd logs or test output.
- CI, `--json`, pipes, `NO_COLOR`, narrow terminals: byte-identical to current behavior.

## Evidence

Live recording of this branch's actual module (tsx-driven, Ghostty, macOS — molt wipe → shimmer → snips, randomized garnish across loops):

![animated banner](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/steipete/openclaw-pr-assets/main/cli-wizard-mascot-banner/claw-banner-animated-live.gif)

- New `src/cli/claw-banner.test.ts`: static gating (non-TTY, CI-on-TTY), narrow fallback, animated run settles on the exact static banner with cursor hidden/restored, rng varies frame count.
- `printWizardHeader` delegation tests updated for async in `src/commands/onboard-helpers.test.ts`.
- oxfmt + oxlint clean on all eight touched files; autoreview + hosted CI on this PR.
